description: Look up one or more Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI, ISO 17442) in the official GLEIF database (CC0): legal name, legal form, jurisdiction, registered and HQ address, national register id, entity and registration status, renewal date and managing LOU. Validates LEI check digits. Sole-proprietor (natural person) records are withheld.

leis.description: LEI codes, 20 characters each, e.g. 549300A0JPRWG1KI7U06 (Nokia Oyj)

name: gleif_lei_lookup
